cases.sentence: ___ читал, вертя в руки и стараясь оторвать чудержавшуюся пуговицу курточки.
cases.translation: The boy was reading, twisting in his hands and trying to pull off the barely-hanging button of his little jacket.
cases.explain: Мальчик is the subject of читал (was reading), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Анна, Золовка, была жена одного из важнейших ___ в Петербурге.
cases.translation: Anna, the sister-in-law, was the wife of one of the most important people in Petersburg.
cases.explain: Лиц follows the partitive construction одного из (one of), which requires the genitive plural.

cases.translation: She had gotten everything ready for her arrival.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward, for) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Мать оторвала ___ и положила ее в карман.
cases.translation: The mother pulled off the button and put it in her pocket.
cases.explain: Пуговицу is the direct object of the transitive verb оторвала (pulled off), so it is accusative.

cases.sentence: Долли была убита своим ___, вся поглощена им.
cases.translation: Dolly was crushed by her grief, entirely consumed by it.
cases.explain: Горем expresses the means/cause of being убита (crushed), governed by the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Доля сидела в маленькой ___ с белоголовым пухлым мальчиком.
cases.translation: Dolly was sitting in the small drawing room with a white-headed plump boy.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating location governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Когда Анна вошла в комнату, Доля сидела в маленькой гостиной с белоголовым пухлым мальчиком, уж теперь похожим на отца, и слушала его урок из французского чтения.
reading.question: Who was Dolly sitting with when Anna entered the room?
options: Her white-haired plump boy who now resembled his father
reading.correct: Her white-haired plump boy who now resembled his father
reading.explain: The text says Dolly was sitting with a white-headed plump boy who now resembled his father, listening to his French reading lesson.

reading.ru: «Успокой ты руки, Гриша», — сказала она и опять взялась за свое одеяло, давнишнюю работу, за которую она всегда бралась тяжелые минуты, и теперь вязала нервно, закидывая пальцем и считая петли.
reading.question: What did Dolly pick up again after telling Grisha to calm his hands?
options: Her knitting, a long-standing task she always turned to in hard moments
reading.correct: Her knitting, a long-standing task she always turned to in hard moments
reading.explain: She went back to her blanket-work (knitting), her old task that she always took up in difficult moments.

reading.ru: «Да, наконец, Анна ни в чем не виновата», — думала Долли.
reading.question: What did Dolly conclude about Anna's guilt?
options: That Anna was not at all to blame
That Anna was partly to blame
That Anna had caused the quarrel
reading.correct: That Anna was not at all to blame
reading.explain: Dolly thought, 'after all, Anna is not at all to blame.'

reading.ru: Все утешения и увещания, и прощения христианские, все это я уж тысячу раз передумала, и все это не годится.
reading.question: How does Dolly feel about consolations, admonitions, and Christian forgiveness?
options: She has thought them over a thousand times already and none of it helps
She believes only religion can help her
reading.correct: She has thought them over a thousand times already and none of it helps
reading.explain: Dolly says she has thought over all consolations and Christian forgiveness a thousand times, and none of it is any good.

reading.ru: Она, как часто бывает, глядя на часы, ждала ее каждую минуту и пропустила именно ту, когда гостья приехала, так что не слыхала звонка.
reading.question: What irony does the text describe about Dolly waiting for Anna?
options: Despite watching the clock every minute, she missed the very moment the guest arrived and didn't hear the bell
She fell asleep waiting for Anna
She left the house right before Anna arrived
She heard the bell too early and was startled
reading.correct: Despite watching the clock every minute, she missed the very moment the guest arrived and didn't hear the bell
reading.explain: As often happens, though she watched the clock every minute, she missed the exact moment the guest arrived and did not hear the bell.

reading.ru: «Ну, пойдем, я тебя проведу в твою комнату», — продолжала она, стараясь отдалить сколько возможно минуту объяснения.
reading.question: Why does Dolly offer to show Anna to her room right away?
options: To put off the moment of explanation as long as possible
Because Anna asked to rest immediately
Because the room needed to be prepared
Because Stiva told her to hurry
reading.correct: To put off the moment of explanation as long as possible
reading.explain: She tries to show Anna to her room, trying to delay the moment of explanation as much as possible.

reading.ru: «Ну так пойдем к ним», — сказала она.
reading.question: What does Dolly suggest after Anna asks to see all the children?
options: That they go to the children
That they go to Anna's room
reading.correct: That they go to the children
reading.explain: Dolly says, 'Well then, let's go to them,' referring to the children Anna wanted to see.

reading.ru: Она ждала теперь притворно-сочувственных фраз, но Анна ничего такого не сказала.
reading.question: What did Dolly expect from Anna, but did not get?
reading.correct: Falsely sympathetic phrases
reading.explain: Dolly expected pretend-sympathetic phrases from Anna, but Anna said nothing of the kind.

reading.ru: И как только она сказала это, выражение лица ее вдруг смягчилось.
reading.question: What happened to Dolly's expression right after she said 'Everything is lost'?
reading.correct: It suddenly softened
reading.explain: As soon as she said that everything was lost, her expression suddenly softened.

reading.ru: Дети, я связана, а с ним жить я не могу, мне мука видеть его».
reading.question: Why does Dolly say she cannot simply leave her husband?
options: Because of the children, she is bound to him even though living with him is torture
Because she still loves him deeply
Because she has nowhere else to go
reading.correct: Because of the children, she is bound to him even though living with him is torture
reading.explain: Dolly says the children bind her, yet living with him is torment and she cannot bear to see him.

reading.ru: «Изволь», — вдруг сказала она, — «но я скажу сначала.
reading.question: What does Dolly agree to do for Anna?
options: Tell her everything, starting from the beginning
Leave the house with the children
reading.correct: Tell her everything, starting from the beginning
reading.explain: Dolly agrees ('Very well') and says she will tell it from the beginning, as Anna asked to hear everything.

reading.ru: Ты пойми, что я не только не подозревала неверности, но что я считала это невозможным.
reading.question: What did Dolly believe about infidelity before she learned the truth?
options: That she not only did not suspect it, but considered it impossible
That it was common among married men
That Stiva had warned her about it
reading.correct: That she not only did not suspect it, but considered it impossible
reading.explain: Dolly says she not only did not suspect unfaithfulness but considered it impossible.

reading.ru: «Я понимаю, еще увлечение...» — продолжала она, помолчав.
reading.question: What does Dolly say she could understand, pausing before she says it?
reading.correct: A passing infatuation
reading.explain: After a pause, Dolly says she could understand 'a mere infatuation.'

reading.ru: «И ты думаешь, что он понимает весь ужас моего положения?» — продолжала Долли.
reading.question: What does Dolly ask Anna about her husband's understanding?
options: Whether he understands the full horror of her situation
Whether he has told anyone else
reading.correct: Whether he understands the full horror of her situation
reading.explain: Dolly asks whether Anna thinks he understands the whole horror of her (Dolly's) position.

reading.ru: «Нет-нет, она не простит, все говорит он!»
reading.question: According to Dolly, what does her husband keep saying?
options: That she will not forgive him
reading.correct: That she will not forgive him
reading.explain: Dolly reports that he keeps saying she will not forgive him.

reading.ru: Мне жить с ним теперь будет мучение именно потому, что я любила его, как любила, что я люблю свою прошедшую любовь к нему».
reading.question: Why does Dolly say living with her husband now would be torment?
options: Precisely because she loved him so much and still loves that past love
Because she never loved him at all
Because he no longer speaks to her
reading.correct: Precisely because she loved him so much and still loves that past love
reading.explain: She says living with him will be torment exactly because she loved him so, and still loves her past love for him.

reading.ru: Я отслужила ему, и на этой службе ушло все мое, и ему теперь, разумеется, свежее, пошлое существо приятнее.
reading.question: What bitter comparison does Dolly make about herself and the other woman?
options: That she gave her best years to him and now a fresher, vulgar creature is more pleasing to him
That the other woman is older than her
That she was always more beautiful than the other woman
That the other woman has no children
reading.correct: That she gave her best years to him and now a fresher, vulgar creature is more pleasing to him
reading.explain: Dolly says she served him and used up all she had in that service, so now a fresher, vulgar creature is more pleasant to him.

reading.ru: Прежде это бывала радость, теперь мучение.
reading.question: How does Dolly now feel about teaching Grisha, compared to before?
options: It used to be a joy, now it is torment
It is now more enjoyable than before
She has stopped teaching him altogether
reading.correct: It used to be a joy, now it is torment
reading.explain: Dolly says teaching Grisha used to be a joy, but now it is torment.

reading.ru: Анна ничего не могла придумать, но сердце ее прямо отзывалось на каждое слово, на каждое выражение лица невестки.
reading.question: How does Anna respond to Dolly's despair, even though she has no solution?
options: Her heart responds directly to every word and every look on Dolly's face
She grows impatient and changes the subject
She suggests Dolly leave her husband immediately
reading.correct: Her heart responds directly to every word and every look on Dolly's face
reading.explain: Though Anna could think of nothing to advise, her heart responded to every word and every expression on her sister-in-law's face.

reading.ru: Я видела только его и то, что семья расстроена.
reading.question: What does Anna admit she initially saw when Stiva first spoke to her?
options: Only him and the fact that the family was upset
reading.correct: Only him and the fact that the family was upset
reading.explain: Anna admits that at first she saw only Stiva and that the family was disrupted, not the full horror of Dolly's position.

reading.ru: Настолько ли есть, чтобы можно было простить?
reading.question: What question does Anna raise about Dolly's remaining love for her husband?
options: Whether there is enough of it left to allow forgiveness
Whether Dolly ever loved him at all
Whether the children still love their father
Whether forgiveness is even possible in general
reading.correct: Whether there is enough of it left to allow forgiveness
reading.explain: Anna asks whether there is enough love left in Dolly's soul to make forgiveness possible.

reading.ru: Эти люди делают неверности, но свой домашний очаг и жена — это для них святыня.
reading.question: What does Anna claim about men like Stiva regarding their wives and home?
options: That their home and wife remain sacred to them even though they are unfaithful
That they never truly love their wives
That they always leave their families eventually
That their wives are replaceable to them
reading.correct: That their home and wife remain sacred to them even though they are unfaithful
reading.explain: Anna says such men are unfaithful, but their own home and wife remain a sanctuary to them.

reading.ru: Я помню это время, когда он приезжал ко мне и плакал, говоря о тебе.
reading.question: What does Anna recall about Stiva when he was courting Dolly?
options: That he used to come to her and weep while speaking about Dolly
That he never mentioned Dolly to her
That he asked Anna to intervene
reading.correct: That he used to come to her and weep while speaking about Dolly
reading.explain: Anna remembers the time when Stiva would come to her and cry while talking about Dolly.

reading.ru: Я не была бы той уже, да, но простила бы.
reading.question: What does Anna say about herself if she were in Dolly's position and chose to forgive?
options: She would not be the same person, but she would forgive
She would forgive but never speak to him again
She would forgive only if he left the other woman
She would forgive immediately without hesitation
reading.correct: She would not be the same person, but she would forgive
reading.explain: Anna says she would not be the same as before, but she would forgive.
